about: Retextures (GameData/overrides/textures) judged wrong in play, for tools/remaster_textures.py until they are regenerated (docs/retexture.md). Name (lower case) -> {use, why}: use 'original' keeps the original texture, 'exact' takes the texel-exact colour lock (only detail finer than one original texel stays, as pack v1 had it) instead of the low-frequency lock.

b_level1_clouds.why: lev_4_m3's river surface (4_3_water): the override paints a cluster of white blobs with dark rims into the soft clouds; the colour lock keeps their hard edges, drawn as pale lily pads over the murky water (walk-video findings B3, 2026-10-25; work/texfix/B3_*.jpg)

2m1_ground3.why: the rock of lev_2_m1 / 2_m2 / 3_m1 / 3_m2: the override is long brushed streaks ('fur'); the low-frequency lock (2026-10-24) kept them, stretched along the rock faces with hard seams (findings B5; work/texfix/B5_*.jpg); the exact lock (pack v1) did not

b_stone.why: the boulders and stone faces of lev_3_m2 / lev_4_m3: the override's leathery folds, kept by the low-frequency lock, read as wrinkled hide (findings B5)
